title: Cha Dash theme document
description: A theme is a versioned token document. The generator compiles it to CSS custom properties; the hub validates it and refuses themes that fail the status-pair or contrast checks. Format 1.

id.description: Stable identifier; used as the data-theme attribute value.

scheme.description: Optional. Derived from the base lightness (< 0.5 is dark); if given it must agree.

profile.description: Contrast profile. `standard` gates text at APCA Lc 90/75/60 plus WCAG AA. `dim` is for low-luminance ambient modes (Night); its results are reported, not gated.

monochrome.description: Status is carried by glyph shape and word only; the attention/down colour-separation checks are skipped.

figures.description: Figures for large standalone numbers. Lists and tables are always tabular.

base.description: The app background. Its hue and chroma tint every neutral step; its lightness picks the scheme.

accent.description: Step 9 of the accent scale: progress, selection, links.

contrast.description: 50 = baseline. Below 50 softens surfaces and hairlines only (text never drops below its floor); above 50 raises text targets and hairlines.

ink.description: Hue and chroma at the text end of the neutral scale. Defaults to the base hue at 1.6x its chroma.

overrides.description: Token-by-token overrides of semantic colours. Still validated.

surface.description: How tiles separate: card (A), ruled (column rules, as in B) or flat.

radius.description: Base radius in px; the scale is 0.5x, 1x, 1.5x (tiles), 2.5x, 4x (sheets).

briefing.description: Default Briefing style: A's one-line sentence or B's serif headline with a deck.

frosted.description: Chrome opacity: 1 is solid. Reduced transparency always forces solid.

backdrop.description: Behind the board. Never content over a wallpaper photo.

l.description: Optional lightness. Defaults per scheme to the M0 validated values.

font.description: Bundled open-source fonts only. Self-hosted user fonts come later.
